H1.name: ONE-SHOT-PIPELINE
H1.when: small, crisp, low-risk; one pass is plausible
stop_conditions: the independent verifier APPROVEs and a draft PR exists
the verifier REJECTs twice: supersede with H2, H3 or H4 rather than grinding
budget class exhausted

H2.name: ITERATE-TO-GREEN
stop_conditions: the verifier runs the gate itself, from a clean state, and it passes
max_iterations reached: NEEDS_INPUT with the last failure
stagnation: 3 rounds with the same failing signature, NEEDS_INPUT
no_progress: 5 rounds without the failure count falling, NEEDS_INPUT
budget class exhausted

H3.name: TDD-LOOP
H3.when: behavior is test-first specifiable and "done" is a runnable command
stop_conditions: every new test failed before the implementation and passes after it
the verifier runs the whole gate itself, from a clean state, and it passes
max_iterations reached: NEEDS_INPUT with the last failure
stagnation: 3 rounds with the same failing signature, NEEDS_INPUT
no_progress: 5 rounds without the failure count falling, NEEDS_INPUT
budget class exhausted

H4.name: REVIEW-FIX-LOOP
stop_conditions: the independent reviewer APPROVEs with evidence, not with agreement
3 rounds without an APPROVE: NEEDS_INPUT with the open objections verbatim
the reviewer returns ESCALATE_HUMAN: NEEDS_INPUT, do not out-argue it
budget class exhausted

H5.name: BABYSITTER-FOLLOWUP
stop_conditions: the PR is closed or merged by someone else: never by you
the operator says stop, or the fleet settles
a poll that finds nothing new must early-exit under ~5k tokens
budget class exhausted (500k/day)

H6.name: RESEARCH-SPIKE
H6.when: the deliverable is a report, an RCA or an estimate, not code
stop_conditions: every question the ticket asks is answered, with a source per claim
no production file was changed: a spike that edits code is the wrong harness
the fact-checker APPROVEs the report against its sources
budget class exhausted
